thesis: Royalty Pharma plc is the largest buyer of pharmaceutical royalties and a partner to biotech innovators. **[Fact]** The company holds royalties on more than 35 commercial therapies and receives payments tied to partners' product sales. **[Fact]** FY2025 portfolio revenue was $2.38 billion; operating income was $1.56 billion. **[Fact]** Class A shareholders received $0.88 per share in dividends in 2025 (~$378 million). **[Fact]** The balance sheet carries about $9.6 billion of debt against $19.6 billion of assets (Dec 31, 2025). The stock trades on NASDAQ as RPRX.
why_market_wrong: The market may be pricing **portfolio growth and new royalty deployment** more than near-term cash returned to Class A holders. **[Inference]** At ~$55 per share, the implied multiple on reported earnings is high versus the dividend yield (~1.6%). **[Inference]** If royalty collections grow with partner sales and management continues accretive acquisitions without over-levering, today's price could be fair on a look-through asset basis even when a conservative ten-year cash-flow model clears poorly. **[Inference]** Complexity from noncontrolling interests (RPI LLC / Class B) may keep generalist investors away, creating a specialist inefficiency rather than a simple earnings miss.
